title: Couscous à base de farine de riz (Rice Flour Couscous)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Rice soaked about an hour, dried about 2 hours and ground to flour, then cooked as the maize couscous: about 15 minutes after the boil, flour added, 10 more minutes; served hot with a sauce.
longDesc: p. 12 of the October 2023 recipe book. The rice is soaked in cold water about an hour, dried about 2 hours and ground. The couscous follows the maize method: a flour ‘milk’ in boiling water, about 15 minutes after the boil resumes, then the rice flour is added and cooked 10 more minutes. Served hot with sauce. No quantities are printed.
ingredients: Cold water for soaking and for the ‘milk’ — quantity not printed
steps: Soak the rice in cold water about an hour. Dry about 2 hours. Grind to flour.
Boil water. Mix a little flour with cold water into a ‘milk’ and pour it in, stirring.
Cook about 15 minutes after the boil resumes.
Add the rice flour and cook 10 more minutes.
chefTips: The printed note is to serve hot with a sauce.
The drying time is printed as about 2 hours.
commonMistakes: Grinding the rice while still wet.
healthBenefits: Rice couscous is a plain starch.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Couscous à base de farine de riz’ (p. 12). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 4 and prep are placeholders. TWO-PASS.
